## Dog Form (CR 8)

NE Small augmented undead (extraplanar)  

**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., detect evil, low-light vision, scent; Perception +15  
**Aura** aura of menace (DC 19), magic circle against evil  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 13, flat-footed 26 (+15 natural, +3 Dex, +1 Size; +2 deflection vs. evil)  
**hp** 55 (10d8+10) fast healing 5  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +6, **Will** +7; +4 vs. poison, +2 resistance vs. evil  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +4, **DR** 10/evil and bludgeoning; **Immune** cold, electricity, petrification, undead traits; **SR** 15  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +13 (1d4+5 plus trip)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th)  


Constant—detect evil, magic circle against evil  

At Will—aid, continual flame, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only), message  



**Statistics**


**Str** 19, **Dex** 16, Con –, **Int** 13, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 23 (27 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Intimidate +16, Perception +15, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +20, Survival +16; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Stealth, +4 Survival  
**SQ** change shape (beast shape II), deathless  


**Special Abilities**


**Change Shape (Su)** A hound archon can assume any canine form of Small to Large size, as if using beast shape II. While in canine form, the hound archon loses its bite and claw attacks, but gains the bite attack of the form it chooses.
